description: Wever Watch: cancel a watch owned by the calling wallet. Checks stop at once and a check already in flight is discarded. Fires already recorded stay readable through wever_watch-status. Cancelling an ended watch returns its final state. POST /api/watch-cancel. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/watch-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/watch/.
name: wever_watch-cancel
title: Cancel a watch
